description:
Read an RS3 player's published hiscores ranks, levels and experience, including Overall. Use search_wiki for training guides rather than player data.
- username is the literal in-game display name, including spaces; the server URL-encodes it. gameMode chooses a separate leaderboard, not a filter on normal stats. Omit it for normal mode.
- Normal, ironman and hardcore boards are supported. A player absent from the selected board returns a 404 tool error; the tool never substitutes another board. Unranked skills use rank Unranked; unavailable level/XP becomes 0.
- No login, account changes or local cache. HTTP shares a default 60 requests/IP/minute budget; honor Retry-After on 429.
name: get_player_stats

rank.description: Hiscores rank, or the string Unranked

outputSchema.description: Map of RS3 skill name to hiscores row. Overall is included.

title: Get Player Stats
